fato_historico: 2020: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War: An armistice agreement is signed by Armenia, Azerbaijan and Russia.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to seek profound resolution today. Much like the historic moment when long-standing tensions finally found their way toward a peaceful accord, you may discover that buried conflicts are ready to dissolve. It is a good time to release old emotional baggage and embrace a newfound serenity that harmonizes your inner world with your surroundings.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courage to seek peace and begin anew.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of energy and personal transformation.
conselho: Consider letting go of past grudges to make space for beautiful new opportunities.
